A '''shock buzzer''' was a device that produced an electric shock and was available during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Kira Carsen]] once contemplated putting a shock buzzer in the chair of [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] as a practical joke.<ref name="Compliment" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shock buzzers were mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[BioWare]]-[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released in [[2011]], during the conversation "Paying a Compliment" with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class's companion character Kira Carsen.<ref name="Compliment" />
